title: Fix encode and subtitle verification regressions
summary: Fixes encode-stage HDR verification context failures and false subtitle topology failures, while retaining completed encode output when an unexpected post-encode exception occurs.
reason: Runtime evidence showed 58 encode failures caused by assigning an undeclared Hdr10Verification context property and 23 remux failures caused by missing ffprobe disposition data plus a source-track ordering mismatch against mkvmerge output order.
behavior_before: Encode verification could throw after media creation because the context did not declare Hdr10Verification, and the catch path deleted the completed temporary output. Subtitle verification omitted default/forced dispositions and compared preserved streams in policy-plan order instead of mkvmerge source-TID order, producing false forced-flag mismatches.
behavior_after: Encode contexts declare Hdr10Verification, and unexpected failures retain a non-empty completed temporary output as the failure artifact while cleaning the scratch input. Subtitle discovery requests disposition fields explicitly, and verification models preserved source tracks in mkvmerge source-TID order.
manual_validation: RED: Invoke-EncodeCoreSplitChecks.ps1 failed before production edits because Hdr10Verification was absent; passed after the fix.
RED: Invoke-SubtitleBuilderDecisionChecks.ps1 failed before production edits for missing disposition selection and source-TID ordering; passed after the fix.
Invoke-ToolIntegrationChecks.ps1 - passed with bundled FFmpeg, ffprobe, and subtitle tooling
Invoke-AdversarialForceKillEncodeChecks.ps1 - passed; interrupted output remained partial and source remained queued
Read-only Test-MediaTrackOutputVerification against one retained NIPPON artifact and one retained Wistoria artifact - both allowed with zero mismatches
Invoke-WebViewReliabilityChecks.ps1 - passed in isolation after an earlier full release self-test failed late with non-media WebView output
PSScriptAnalyzer on six changed PowerShell files - no errors
git diff --check on packet paths - passed; only repository line-ending notices were emitted
refresh_summaries --paths and --check for six changed source/test files - passed
ai_guardrail postflight - passed across 579 changed worktree paths

Release self-test with tool integration and end-to-end smoke skipped - failed only in pre-existing dirty WebView state: clean test_application_facade_web_static_cross_page.py expects a pendingInvestigationFilter listener absent from the modified static bundle
rollback_plan: Remove the Hdr10Verification context property, restore unconditional unexpected-failure TempOut cleanup, restore the previous ffprobe show_entries selector, restore policy-plan ordering for verification tracks, and remove the focused regression assertions. Runtime failure markers and source files are not modified by this change.
notes:
Add RED coverage for the missing HDR context field and retained completed temp output.
Add RED coverage for subtitle disposition probing and mkvmerge output ordering.
Declare the HDR10 verification stage handoff field.
Retain a completed temp encode on unexpected post-encode failure.
Request ffprobe subtitle default and forced dispositions explicitly.
Align mkvmerge verification tracks with source-TID output order.
Refresh generated summary after source or test change.
Python impact: none; the implementation and focused regression coverage are PowerShell-only.
Source media, live failure markers, and retained artifacts were inspected read-only and were not mutated. Full operator-controlled live encode/publish was not run because it would mutate runtime state.
The release self-test's remaining WebView assertion is outside this packet: its Python test file is clean while the frontend static tree contains extensive pre-existing modifications.
